articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring significantly improved chain-of-thought reasoning that unifies text, image, audio, and code generation in a single forward pass rather than relying on separate specialist modules. Benchmarks show a 35% improvement on SWE-bench and near-human performance on graduate-level scientific reasoning tasks. The model also introduces a persistent memory layer accessible via API, enabling long-running agentic workflows without context window workarounds.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which scored a verified 92% on a curated set of International Mathematical Olympiad problems, surpassing the previous best AI system by a wide margin. The model uses a novel reinforcement learning approach that rewards formally verified proof steps rather than just final answers, substantially reducing hallucinated reasoning chains. Researchers note the system can now autonomously generate and verify proofs in Lean 4, opening pathways for AI-assisted formal mathematics.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 with 400B MoE Architecture and Full Training Recipe
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4, a 400-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model that activates roughly 52B parameters per forward pass, along with the complete training codebase, dataset composition details, and RLHF pipeline. The open-source release includes optimized inference kernels for consumer GPUs enabling the model to run on a single 48GB card at acceptable throughput. The move intensifies competition in the open-weight ecosystem and gives researchers unprecedented reproducibility for frontier-scale model training.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Unveils Atlas Gen-3 with Real-Time Adaptive Manipulation in Unstructured Environments
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics demonstrated its third-generation electric Atlas robot performing complex warehouse logistics tasks including identifying, grasping, and sorting irregularly shaped objects at near-human speed. The system uses an on-board vision-language-action model that allows it to interpret natural language task instructions and adapt its manipulation strategy in real time without pre-programmed object models. Commercial pilot deployments with DHL and Amazon are slated to begin in Q1 2027.

articles.title: Figure AI's Humanoid Robot Completes 8-Hour Autonomous Shift at BMW Manufacturing Plant
articles.summary: Figure AI reported that its Figure 03 humanoid robot successfully completed a full 8-hour shift on a BMW assembly line in Spartanburg, South Carolina, handling sub-assembly tasks including cable routing, snap-fit component insertion, and quality inspection. The robot operated alongside human workers with zero safety incidents, using a combination of imitation learning and sim-to-real transfer. BMW confirmed plans to expand the pilot from 5 to 50 units across two additional plants by mid-2027.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its N1.4 process node using gate-all-around transistor architecture has entered high-volume manufacturing, approximately one quarter ahead of the original roadmap. The node delivers an 18% performance improvement and 30% power reduction over the N2 node, with early yields reportedly exceeding expectations. Apple and NVIDIA are confirmed as launch customers, with chips expected in consumer devices by late 2027.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface with 4,096 Electrodes
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink clearance to begin human trials of its N2 implant, which quadruples the electrode count of the original device to 4,096 channels and features wireless data transfer at over 200 Mbps. Early primate testing demonstrated the ability to decode complex motor intentions including individual finger movements and handwriting at near-natural speeds. The expanded trial will enroll 30 patients with spinal cord injuries across five clinical sites, with a focus on restoring fine motor control of robotic limbs.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI Oversight Framework Adopted by EU AI Office as Reference Standard
articles.summary: Anthropic published a detailed technical framework for runtime constitutional AI monitoring that provides formal guarantees around output safety boundaries, and the EU AI Office announced its adoption as a reference implementation for high-risk AI system compliance under the AI Act. The framework includes open-source tooling for real-time constraint verification, interpretability dashboards, and automated red-teaming pipelines. Industry observers note this positions Anthropic's safety methodology as a de facto regulatory standard in Europe, potentially shaping global AI governance norms.
